payload: {"announcement":{"body":{"en":"Minimum supported release: r166. Reduces lock contention between touch reception, submission and UI callbacks. When a kernel touch session ends unexpectedly, a read-only input observer supports bounded retries and virtual-screen fallback while retaining the preferred touch settings. Adds a one-time diagnostic request: create an empty regular file named remote-diagnostics.once in the active miku-config directory. On the next interactive launch, consent is requested before resource downloads and driver checks; a pairing code is shown only after approval. The request file is consumed once, including on cancellation. The existing hidden diagnostic entry remains available. Settings are preserved at configuration version 1 without repeating completed migrations. After downloading, exit the old version and run the new script manually from the same working directory.","zh":"最低支持版本调整为 r166。优化触摸接收、提交与 UI 回调之间的锁依赖，降低界面操作对触摸提交的阻塞。内核触摸会话异常结束后切换到只读输入并进行有限重试，必要时回退虚拟屏；保留原触摸偏好设置。新增一次性远程诊断入口：在实际 miku-config 配置目录创建 0 字节普通文件 remote-diagnostics.once，下次在交互终端启动时，在资源下载和驱动检查之前显示本次授权；允许后才显示配对码。请求文件自动删除，取消也不会反复弹出。原隐藏诊断入口保留。保留配置，配置版本仍为 1，不重复重置已迁移设置。下载完成后退出旧版，在原工作目录手动运行新脚本。"},"id":"r166-touch-recovery-startup-diagnostics-20261029","title":{"en":"r166: touch responsiveness, recovery and startup diagnostics","zh":"r166：触摸响应、异常恢复与远程诊断入口"}},"channel":"stable","latest":166,"minSupported":166,"package":{"fileName":"miku-20261029-154834.sh","sha256":"e68d379f1e22391e147d70191ef0240a8a6ac19bac89c1eb08d3fcf399071bbb","size":9306195,"url":"https://github.com/mikuliming/miku-releases/releases/download/r166/miku-20261029-154834.sh"},"policyRevision":22,"schemaVersion":1,"versionName":"r166"}
